# vyos.blueprints.dmvpn

DMVPN (docs blueprint "DMVPN Dual HUB Dual Cloud")

- NHRP on multipoint GRE tunnels for hubs (`multicast dynamic`, `redirect`) and spokes (NHS with NBMA address, `shortcut`), IPsec transport-mode protection through an IPsec profile bound to the tunnels, and an output-filter rule dropping GRE that is not protected by IPsec, as the docs page recommends.
- The mGRE tunnel interfaces belong to `vyos.blueprints.gre_tunnel` (address /32, no remote, `enable_multicast`, `key`); the routing protocol over them to `vyos.blueprints.ospf`.
- NHRP is configured with vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos.vyos has no NHRP module; IPsec uses vyos_vpn_ipsec and the GRE rule vyos_firewall_rules. The NHRP authentication string and the PSK are masked.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.dmvpn
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels` | list |  | `[]` | NHRP per tunnel. |
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels.name` | str | yes |  | Tunnel interface, e.g. `tun100`. |
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels.network_id` | int | yes |  | NHRP network id (one per cloud). |
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels.authentication` | str |  |  | NHRP authentication string. |
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels.holdtime` | int |  |  | Hold time in seconds. |
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels.multicast` | str |  |  | `dynamic` on hubs, the hub's NBMA address on spokes. |
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels.redirect` | bool |  | `false` | Send NHRP redirects (hubs, DMVPN phase 3). |
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels.shortcut` | bool |  | `false` | Accept NHRP shortcuts (spokes, DMVPN phase 3). |
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels.registration_no_unique` | bool |  | `false` | Allow re-registration from a changed NBMA address. |
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels.nhs` | list |  | `[]` | Next-hop servers (spokes). |
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels.nhs.tunnel_ip` | str |  | `dynamic` | Hub tunnel address, or `dynamic`. |
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels.nhs.nbma` | str | yes |  | Hub's public (NBMA) address. |
| `dmvpn_ipsec` | dict |  |  | IPsec protection of the tunnels. Omit for unencrypted DMVPN. |
| `dmvpn_ipsec.interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Interfaces IPsec listens on, e.g. `[eth0]`. |
| `dmvpn_ipsec.ike_group` | dict | yes |  | IKE group - name, key_exchange, lifetime, proposal_id, dh_group, encryption, hash. |
| `dmvpn_ipsec.esp_group` | dict | yes |  | ESP group - name, lifetime, mode (transport), pfs, proposal_id, encryption, hash. |
| `dmvpn_ipsec.profile` | dict | yes |  | IPsec profile bound to the tunnels. |
| `dmvpn_ipsec.profile.name` | str | yes |  | Profile name, e.g. `NHRPVPN`. |
| `dmvpn_ipsec.profile.psk` | str | yes |  | Pre-shared secret. |
| `dmvpn_ipsec.profile.bind_tunnels` | list | yes |  | Tunnels the profile protects. |
| `dmvpn_drop_unprotected_gre` | dict |  |  | Drop GRE not protected by an outbound IPsec policy, e.g. `{rule: 10}`. Put it before any rule permitting GRE. |
| `dmvpn_drop_unprotected_gre.rule` | int |  | `10` | Output-filter rule number. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. On spokes, checks the NHRP registration to every NHS; with IPsec, checks an SA is up for every protected tunnel.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dmvpn_nhrp_tunnels` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
| `dmvpn_ipsec` | dict |  |  | Same value as for `main`. |
